paras: Letheobia wittei, also known commonly as De Witte's gracile blind snake or Witte's beaked snake, is a species of snake in the family Typhlopidae. The species is endemic to Africa.
The specific name, wittei, is in honor of Belgian herpetologist Gaston-François de Witte.
The preferred natural habitat of L. wittei is lowland rainforest.
